description: Bathtime just got a little more natural. Made from 100% Konjac plant fibre and nothing else, our Natural Baby Bath Sponge is incredibly soft, naturally gentle and kind to even the most delicate newborn skin.. Use it with warm water alone in those early weeks, or add a small amount of our Gentle Hair & Body Wash when you're ready to introduce a cleanser. Either way, it leaves baby's skin clean, soft and refreshed.. Why you'll love it:. 100% Konjac plant fibre - plant-based and plastic-free. Soft enough for newborns from day one. Perfect for topping and tailing. Use with water alone or with your favourite baby wash. Kind to sensitive skin. Lasts 1–3 months with good care. Compostable at end of life. Cardboard box sourced with care - please recycle. Available in our Newborn Essentials Kit and Kokoso Baby Collection.
